findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_congress_trades, get_insider_trades, get_activist_stakes · Private data: analyze_stock, analyze_fund, find_signals, compare_funds, clone_fund, search_filers, search_securities, list_quarters, get_congress_trades, analyze_politician, get_insider_trades, get_activist_stakes, get_fund_holdings, get_stock_holders, get_13f_activity · Public sink: analyze_fund, get_insider_trades, get_stock_holders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_congress_trades, get_insider_trades, get_activist_stakes · Private data: analyze_stock, analyze_fund, find_signals, compare_funds, clone_fund, search_filers, search_securities, list_quarters, get_congress_trades, analyze_politician, get_insider_trades, get_activist_stakes, get_fund_holdings, get_stock_holders, get_13f_activity · Public sink: analyze_fund, get_insider_trades, get_stock_holders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
